effect_of_pass: Approve the exact profile for bounded implementation but keep active=false until every implementation and activation condition passes.
effect_of_defer: Keep repository-bot write denied and preserve the gate-ready evidence for later review.
effect_of_block: Keep repository-bot write denied and require a new or corrected proposal before reconsideration.
effect_of_quarantine: Keep repository-bot write denied and isolate the proposal/evidence pending an identified safety or reproducibility resolution.
effect_of_supersede: Keep this proposal inactive and require a new immutable authority profile and gate packet.
